content.theory:
Every real page has a common skeleton: a header, some navigation, main content, and a footer. HTML5 gives you **semantic tags** that describe these regions — better for screen readers, SEO, and other developers than sprinkling `
` everywhere. ### The classic layout ```html
Links go here
Main content
Sidebar
Copyright info
``` ### Semantic tags | Tag | Purpose | |-----|---------| | `
` | Top banner — logo, title, nav | | `
` | Navigation links | | `

` | A themed chunk of content | | `
` | A self-contained piece (blog post, card) | | `
` | Tangential content (sidebar, ads) | | `
` | Bottom info — contact, copyright | ### Sectioning ```html
